meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI 的命令行与网关，配置 Agent Vault；把 .env 中的 Anthropic 凭据迁入保险库并删除原值，其他容器凭据经你同意后再迁移；随后重建并重启服务，若无凭据则引导录入新凭据。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 将 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入后，或首次设置 OneCLI 时，可以调用本技能进入初始化流程。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault。
say.note: 进入初始化流程；先检查是否已配置。
按破坏性变更场景开始初始化。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI CLI and gateway, configures Agent Vault; migrates Anthropic credentials from .env into the vault and removes the original lines, moves other container secrets after user approval; then rebuilds and restarts the service. If no credentials exist, guides the user to register new ones.
howto.when_en: After /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or on first-time OneCLI setup, when this skill is invoked.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI Agent Vault for me.
say_en.note: Runs the initialization flow; checks configuration first.

say_en.text: Migrate ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env into the OneCLI vault.
say_en.note: The original key line is removed from .env after migration.

say_en.text: Just ran /update-nanoclaw, set up OneCLI now.
say_en.note: Starts initialization for the breaking-change scenario.
